question: How many wild poliovirus cases did Pakistan and Afghanistan report in 2025?
text:
In 2025, Pakistan and Afghanistan reported 52 wild poliovirus type 1 (WPV1) cases combined. The WHO's Polio IHR Emergency Committee puts this at 21 in Afghanistan and 31 in Pakistan.[1]

The 2025 figures have been revised upward since the year ended. A December 2025 report counted only 9 cases in Afghanistan and 30 in Pakistan[2]. Afghanistan's total rose later, and the WHO's latest figure for it is 21. Part of the increase was cases with 2025 paralysis onset that were reported in 2026. The Kabul Tribune notes that 11 of Afghanistan's 14 newly reported cases at one point had paralysis onset in 2025.[3]

For comparison, 2024 had 25 cases in Afghanistan and 74 in Pakistan.[4] That means Pakistan's count fell sharply in 2025, while Afghanistan's was lower but less dramatically so.
